full_page.content:
1937, February
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 165 Cont.
Feb. 1 Anthony Byzewsk - 27 - had Ep. fits since 21 - was enrolled last Oct. 12 perpetually - has been enrolling Pr. Souls off and on since. He wants to thank God and all who have prayed for him seems to be coming O.K.
2 young lady planing marriage to divorced -
Mary Schwab - 60 - breast cancer - over two yrs. Enrolled over a year ago & poor souls every month since last October. ... The cancer seems very threatening but since enrolled ... no pain ... pray.
Page 166
Feb. 2 Ada P. Baker - 68 - Cancer of face
2 Sophie Honer - 55 - Kidney trouble, screams for pain . . ..
Baby Thomas Beshaw - 9 mo. - pneumonia influenzia manengitis .. En- rolled To-night at 9:15 50¢
3 Betty Letson - 28 - non C. kidney trouble Henry Siebert ...
Leon Bidaul - 6 - nerveous
Page 167
Feb. 8 Ronald Myers - 16 mo. - Lutheran - like paralysis ... no use of limbs - never tried to sit up - spasims every 2nd day.
8 Robert English - 10 - diabetis often in coma for two days at a time.
Arthur Decker - 57 - has family depending on him - hopes to be able to go back to work soon.
Jeanette Mireau - 22 - rhumatic fever six months ago left very stiff leg and painful at times.
9 Cath. McNichol - 47 - cataracts - almost blind ..... Miss Mamie Burke - 60 - operation on very threatening goitre to- morrow ...
10 Geo. Norris - 20 - only son and support of widowed mother. Is in cast now with tuburcular spine. Operation this p.m.
